exclusions_and_cautions.reason: Protests reported in Berlin, Munich, London, and other diaspora locations occurred outside Albania; exclude from Albania country event leads even when they concern the same issue.
Opened page is dated May 16, 2017 and describes May 13, 2017, despite search context; wrong period.
Embassy/police scheduling and traffic advisories establish planned gatherings only. Occurrence should be grounded in post-event material.

exclusions_and_cautions.item: Large turnout and cumulative protest totals
exclusions_and_cautions.reason: No turnout totals or movement-wide counts were accepted. Reports use estimates and sometimes describe repeated/nightly action; require event-level provenance and avoid treating a series as one event.
A search that returns irrelevant results, a 403, or an open error does not establish that no event occurred.
